marta_fin: FYI vendor_orchid invoice OR-1129 (23 Jun 2025) submitted with a W-8BEN-E claiming treaty rate 0% withholding. Vendor didn't attach a signed form or chapter 3 withholding certificate. Holding payment.

leo_ops: @marta_fin can you request a signed W-8BEN-E PDF? Also ask for EIN/foreign TIN and beneficial owner name to match invoice.

vendor_orchid: Hi team  we submitted W-8BEN-E via our tax portal but the export didn't include signature image. Our foreign TIN is IN-987654321 and legal name is Orchid Data Services Pvt Ltd. We can send a signed PDF.

marta_fin: We need the signed form and a short statement of treaty claim (which article they're relying on). Also confirm whether they want Redwood to gross-up the payment for Indian withholding (10%)  the PO language references "net of taxes" which is ambiguous.

vendor_orchid: Contract clause 6.3 allows supplier to request gross-up where withholding applies. We're requesting treaty relief first; if delays persist we'll submit a gross-up calc.

tax_bot: FYI: For US payers, a valid W-8BEN-E signed and in effect is required to apply Chapter 3 withholding exemption. For India treaty relief, supporting docs like Form 10F/TRC may be needed by tax authorities in some cases. Gross-up is a commercial remedy not automatic.

marta_fin: Practical next steps: 1) signed W-8BEN-E (scanned PDF) 2) statement of treaty article & beneficial owner 3) foreign TIN (received) 4) if gross-up chosen, a detailed gross-up calculation showing withholding rate and resulting gross amount. Payments will remain on hold until we get (1) and (2).

leo_ops: Adding vendor checklist in the ticket: W-8 signed (pending), treaty stmt (pending), foreign TIN (received), gross-up calc (optional). Payments: hold until confirmed.

vendor_orchid: Sending signed W-8BEN-E and treaty statement now. We'll attach a gross-up calc only if you need it.

marta_fin: Received signed W-8BEN-E and treaty statement. Form looks complete and matches IN-987654321. We'll accept the treaty claim and proceed without withholding. Releasing payment on next cycle. If tax authority later questions, vendor must indemnify per contract.

payments_bot: Hold cleared for OR-1129. Payment scheduled for next run.
